name: Splat
tagline: A tiny 3D scene you spin with a finger. The scene lives in this app.
description:
Open it and you are already standing in a small 3D scene — a ring of colour, a few glossy balls, a patch of ground. Drag to look around. On a phone, one finger orbits; pinch with two to move closer or farther. Arrow keys walk, and the letter keys turn, if you have a keyboard.

The scene is packed in this app. Nothing is downloaded, and nothing is sent anywhere.

An unofficial port of splat by antimatter15. The original loads a scene from the internet; this copy carries a tiny one of its own, so it works with no network at all.

If you have a scene file, drop it on the window to look at that instead. What you drop stays on this device.
